allowFracturing.label: Allow Fracturing Orb
allowFracturing.description: Let a Fracturing Orb fracture one random explicit modifier on a rare Idol with four explicit modifiers.

allowVaal.label: Allow Vaal Orb
allowVaal.description: Let a Vaal Orb corrupt an Idol (and let Tainted Chaos and Tainted Exalted Orbs modify corrupted rare Idols).

allowMirror.label: Allow Mirror of Kalandra
allowMirror.description: Let a Mirror of Kalandra create a mirrored copy of a non-unique, uncorrupted Idol.
